_note: Enemy/hazard stats come from balance.json enemy_classes. hits=None means not shootable by 'hits' (unbreakable or special rule in text). A stage theme is NOT a sector (sector = 10 stages).

1.name: EMBER BELT
1.description: A burning asteroid field at the edge of the galaxy. Learn to dodge, shoot and grab power-ups.

items.name: MOLTEN ASTEROID
items.text: Drifts down slowly. Breaks into 2 small rocks when destroyed.

items.name: SPIKE MINE
items.text: Floats in place. Blinks red and explodes if you fly inside its ring.

items.name: SCOUT DRONE
items.text: Flies in zig-zag groups of 3 and fires single red shots.

items.name: FIRE COMET
items.text: A warning line flashes, then a comet streaks across. Just dodge it.

mini_boss.name: CINDER CRAB
mini_boss.text: Slams its claws to send a shockwave along the screen. Dodge in the gap, then shoot its eyes.

2.name: VENOM NEBULA
2.description: A toxic green cloud where an alien hive breeds swarms. Enemies come in packs.

items.name: STINGER SWARM
items.text: Bug fighters in V-formation. They break apart and dive when hit.

items.name: ACID SPORE
items.text: Floats slowly. Pops into 8 acid droplets - shoot it from far away.

items.name: NEBULA EEL
items.text: Long serpent that weaves in a wave. Its body blocks your bullets.

items.name: LEECH POD
items.text: Grabs your jet and slows it by 40% until you shake it off.

mini_boss.name: SPORE MOTHER
mini_boss.text: Lets out a ring of 6 acid spores that drift toward you. Pop them early, then hit the pink eye.

3.name: IRON FLEET
3.description: A robot armada parked around a giant space station. Fly between hulls, turrets and laser gates.

items.name: HULL TURRET
items.text: Bolted onto ship hulls. Turns to aim at you and fires bursts of 3.

items.name: LASER GATE
items.text: A red beam blinks on and off (ON 2s, OFF 1.5s). Time your pass or shoot the posts.

items.name: KAMIKAZE BOT
items.text: Locks on (red target on you) for 1s, then rockets straight at you.

items.name: IRON GUNSHIP
items.text: Heavy fighter facing down at you. Fires a 3-way spread every 2s.

mini_boss.name: RAIL CRUISER
mini_boss.text: Sweeps across the top. A red line shows where its rail beam will fire a second later.

4.name: VOID RIFT
4.difficulty_label: VERY HARD (SectorMap board label: FINAL; Level4 board now says VERY HARD)
4.description: The edge of a black hole where light bends. Gravity pulls you and your bullets.

items.name: VOID WRAITH
items.text: Fades in and out. You can only hit it while its eyes glow.

items.name: GRAVITY WELL
items.text: Pulls your jet and bends your bullets toward its center.

items.name: SHADOW ACE
items.text: A dark copy of YOUR chosen jet. Mirrors your moves and shots.

items.name: RIFT CRYSTAL
items.text: Shatters into 4 homing shards. Keep moving after you break it.

mini_boss.name: RIFT WARDEN
mini_boss.text: Jumps between two portals and fires from the one you are not watching. Shoot it as it steps out.

5.name: FROST REACH
5.description: A frozen belt of icebergs. The cold slows everything, including you.

items.name: ICICLE SHARD
items.text: Hangs in place and drops when you fly under it.

items.name: FROST SPRITE
items.text: Fires slow blue shots that chill your jet.

items.name: SNOW CLOUD
items.text: Slows your jet while you are inside.

items.name: ICE TURRET
items.text: Fires bursts of 3 icicles.
